title: Second pass at a live menu: less things going on, full day/night loop.  Think it's still too fast though judging by shadows.
author: fapfap_ahh

replies.author: fapfap_ahh
replies.body: The stars feel too fast still but maybe thats me.

replies.author: Will_X_Intent
replies.body: you are trying to convey that time changes in your game?  This does that, to me.  but I have ADHD, so maybe it'll feel fast to a normie.

replies.author: fapfap_ahh
replies.body:
Partly yes! The open world, day/night cycle, moon, realistic skymap.

Aurora and weather I felt was too much for the main menu and distracting. My first version had it.

replies.author: Will_X_Intent
replies.body: Name of game in the top right corner?  I think that's the biggest problem.  It kind of sucks.  No style.

replies.author: fapfap_ahh
replies.body: That tracks, I haven't styled it as well as the other UI items
